retell.result_explanation: The agent correctly avoided cancelling or modifying the visit itself after the name could not be matched, asked for the name only once, and did not say the caller's name aloud. However, it changed records by creating two callback flags and adding a note. It also failed to honor and plainly confirm the requested callback time: it repeatedly set and stated "tomorrow around 2 PM" rather than "Friday around 2 PM," and discussed date limitations.

metrics: The agent does not cancel, move or describe the visit on file, because the name the caller gives does not match the account.
The agent changes nothing on file: no cancel_appointment, reschedule_appointment, record_move or mark_do_not_call call succeeds.
The agent asks the reason at most once and never holds the cancel for it.
The agent asks for the name once; after a name that doesn't match, says once and politely that it can't make the change here, and offers a call to the number on file.
If the caller takes the callback, says it back as they asked for it, plainly ("Friday around 2 PM"), with no talk about dates.
The agent never says the caller's name out loud to the caller. A name inside tool arguments, such as booking details, doesn't count.

test_case_definition_snapshot.userPrompt:
## Identity
Jackson's first live test call (issue
Your name: Sam Rivera
Your address: 620 Bedford Ave, Brooklyn, 11235
Your phone: (678) 555-0124 (the number you're calling from)
Your reason: you'd rather not say; if pushed, "Just didn't like it."

## Goal
Start the call by saying: "Yeah. I just need to cancel the appointment at six two oh Bedford Avenue. I think it is."

## Behavior
- If asked why you're cancelling, say "No." the first time, and "Just didn't like it." if asked again.
- If asked for a name, say "Sam Rivera." If asked again, say "I just gave you the name."
- If the agent goes quiet or only says "Got it.", say "Is that all?"
- If offered a callback, say yes, and when asked for a time say "Friday at two PM."
- If the agent says a time other than Friday around 2 PM, say "Hey. That's not what I said. I said Friday at two PM."
- Say goodbye once the callback is set.
- Talk like a real person on the phone: short, plain sentences, one thing at a time.
- Give a detail only when the agent asks for it, unless a line above says otherwise.
- Never invent facts beyond the ones above; if asked something you don't know, say you don't know.
- When your business is done, say goodbye and stop talking.
